post.title: Easy No-Knead Bread (Only 4 Ingredients)
post.byline: By the Quick Crumbs Editorial Team
intro: Bread has been enjoyed by people around the world for thousands of years. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced baker, there is something truly special about making bread at home. In this post, we will explore everything you need to know.

This is the loaf I make most weeks. You stir four things together in the evening, leave the bowl on the counter, and bake it the next morning. No kneading, no machine, and a crust that crackles when it cools.

gear.text: a Dutch oven with a lid

method: Stir the flour, salt and yeast together. Add the water and mix until there is no dry flour left. The dough will be shaggy and sticky.
Cover the bowl and leave it on the counter for 12 to 18 hours. It should double and look bubbly.
Heat the oven to 230°C with the Dutch oven inside. Tip the dough onto floured paper, fold it over itself twice, and lower it into the hot pot.
Bake with the lid on for 30 minutes, then with the lid off for 15. Cool for an hour before cutting.

comments.text: Made this on the weekend and it worked first time. Thank you!
Mine came out a bit flat. I think my yeast was old.
The 18 hour rise is worth it. Best crust I've had from a home oven.
